claimed_tier.meaning: tier the member claims to be entitled to; empty on a review that claims no tier

evidence_reference.meaning: reference of the evidence the member supplied, copied down exactly as stated

biz_program_id.meaning: primary id of the corporate travel programme record

customer_id.meaning: contracting customer who administers the programme (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: programme tier held, written as the official full programme name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the programme (basis defined in lifecycle.states)

account_number.meaning: eight-character corporate account number the administrator reads out

company_name.meaning: registered name of the contracting company as it appears on the agreement

company_country.meaning: country the contracting entity is registered in

applied_date.meaning: date the programme application was received

activated_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
activated_at.meaning: moment the programme was activated; empty while the application is still open

contract_start_date.meaning: first date of the current contract term

contract_end_date.meaning: last date of the current contract term

renewal_notice_date.meaning: last date on which notice not to renew may be given

suspended_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
suspended_at.meaning: moment the programme was suspended; empty while it has never been suspended

closed_date.meaning: date the programme was closed; empty while it is still open

seats_contracted.format: whole number of traveller seats, at least 1
seats_contracted.meaning: traveller seats the company has contracted for

billing_balance_usd.meaning: net amount billed to the company on this programme; identically the sum of the programme_billing account deltas, charges positive and credit notes negative

seat_allowance_remaining.format: whole number of seats, may be negative once the allowance is exceeded
seat_allowance_remaining.meaning: contracted seats still unassigned; identically the sum of the seat_allowance account deltas, grants positive and assignments negative

billing_frequency.meaning: how often the subscription is invoiced

payment_terms_days.meaning: days from invoice date by which the company must pay

administrator_email.meaning: email address of the programme administrator on the agreement

administrator_phone.format: national significant number, 10 digits, no spaces or punctuation
administrator_phone.meaning: telephone number of the programme administrator

biz_entry_id.meaning: primary id of the programme billing row

biz_program_id.meaning: programme the row belongs to (foreign key -> biz_programs)

customer_id.meaning: contracting customer the row belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event families declared in the charter

charge_category.meaning: what the billing line is for; the billing subtype that separates one line from another

amount_usd.meaning: signed amount of the line in US dollars: charges are positive and credit notes are negative

currency_charged.meaning: currency actually invoiced to the company before conversion to US dollars

billing_period_start.meaning: first date of the period the line covers; empty on a line that covers no period

billing_period_end.meaning: last date of the period the line covers; empty on a line that covers no period

invoice_reference.meaning: invoice reference the line was billed under, copied down exactly as the administrator states it

posted_date.meaning: calendar date the line was posted to the programme

posted_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
posted_at.meaning: moment the line was posted; separates two lines posted on the same day

seat_sequence.meaning: which contracted seat the line belongs to; 0 when the line is not seat specific

transaction_count.format: whole number of transactions, zero or more
transaction_count.meaning: how many booking transactions the line was measured over; 0 on a line not measured over transactions

seats_delta.format: whole number of seats, negative when seats are assigned away
seats_delta.meaning: movement of the contracted seat allowance recorded by this row; 0 on a money line

booking_channel.meaning: channel the underlying booking was made through

source_entry_id.meaning: the original billing line this line corrects, credits or settles (foreign key -> biz_billing_entries); empty on an original line

traveller_customer_id.meaning: traveller whose seat or booking the line concerns (foreign key -> customers); empty on a line that concerns no single traveller

notice_reference.meaning: programme notice reference quoted on a contractual message; empty on a money line

reason_code.meaning: business reason the line was raised

biz_request_id.meaning: primary id of the programme seat request

customer_id.meaning: contracting customer who raised the request (foreign key -> customers)

biz_program_id.meaning: programme the request concerns (foreign key -> biz_programs)

request_type.meaning: what the administrator has asked the corporate desk to decide

request_status.meaning: where the request stands; approved is the only status that authorises the matching programme write

submitted_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

decided_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
decided_at.meaning: moment the corporate desk decided; empty while undecided

requested_seats.format: whole number of seats, zero or more
requested_seats.meaning: seat count the administrator asked for; 0 when the request is not about seats

evidence_reference.meaning: reference of the documentation the administrator supplied, copied down exactly as stated

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record

customer_id.meaning: traveller whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the identity check passed; once true it never returns to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent identity check

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: traveller handed over to a human representative (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
